name: Jump Squat
summary: An explosive squat variation that adds a jump to train power in the legs and raise your heart rate.
setup: Stand with feet shoulder width apart on a non-slip surface with room around you.
Hold your hands in front of your chest or let them swing freely.
Brace your abs and keep your chest tall.
execution: Squat down to about parallel by sending your hips back.
Drive through your feet and jump up explosively, extending hips, knees and ankles.
Land softly on the middle of your feet with knees slightly bent.
Absorb the landing by sinking straight into the next squat.
mistakes: Landing stiff-legged: bend your hips and knees to absorb the impact and aim for a quiet landing.
Knees collapsing inward on landing: focus on pushing them out over the toes or reduce the jump height.
Shallow squat before the jump: sink to a consistent depth each rep.
Training while very tired: stop the set when landings become sloppy.
